title: Fence

steps.prompt: A straight three-metre section of rustic wooden rail fence, two posts and two rough rails, modular with flat ends. A single object alone, centred, whole object in frame with margin, three-quarter view from slightly above, plain flat white background, even shadowless lighting, no ground, no hands, no extra objects. Cel-shaded anime game art, flat colours with two-tone shading, clean dark ink outlines on characters and objects, bright saturated palette, blue-violet shadows instead of black, soft clear daylight, simple readable shapes, strong silhouette, hand-painted look, no photorealism, no film grain, no text, no watermark, no logo.

steps.version: TripoSR commit 107cefdc, stabilityai/TripoSR weights, torch 2.11.0+cu128, marching cubes via scikit-image, run by tools/pipeline/triposr_run.py (bundled background remover blocked)

cleanup: Automatic only, by tools/pipeline/blender_finish_model.py: stood upright, welded, decimated to 1800 triangles, smart UV unwrap, vertex colours baked to a 1024 px texture, scaled so the longest side is 3.00 m, origin at the centre of the base.
notes: Input image: stylekit/golden/concepts/con_prop_fence.png. The background was removed with BiRefNet before TripoSR, which ran at marching-cubes resolution 256. BiRefNet, TripoSR and Blender take no seed (seed 0 is a placeholder). Measured: source_tris=36906 final_tris=1800 dims=1.390x3.000x1.560 tex=1024.
